label: Greedy nearest-pair merging
subgoals: Compute Manhattan distances between all current subtrees
Replace the pair by its merge node and repeat

label: Means and medians
subgoals: Sort the sinks by the current cut coordinate
Cut at the median so the halves are equal
Alternate the cut direction and recurse

label: Matching rounds
subgoals: Pair all current subtrees in one round
Sum the lengths of the chosen pairs
Merge every pair to form the next level
